items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...about Alexis too. Yeah, Alexis coming after Rika. [INTERVIEWEE] That's what you got to avoid.

ctx.x: I think he was waiting for the post office now. I don't know if you might be able to catch him. I don't know. He played out there with Ridgely and my parents used to be his old lady. So you know you can ask about Gilbert. He said Gilbert don't stay far from home. When you be out there, just ask about Gilbert Young. I thought I used to be a husband one time. Sweetheart together, live together. I shouldn't even say that. Well that's alright.
Because other people have told me that too. Yeah that's right. Yeah, about Alexis too. Yeah, Alexis coming after Rika.
That's what you got to avoid. And let's see if you talk about some other bands you want to know about. Then after they like...
